Team — kicking off the registration sequence for the 24 June CTO Roundtable: 'Cost-Effective LLM Inference'. Goal: 50 qualified CTO/VP-eng RSVPs + 20% show rate uplift from past events via targeted personal outreach.

Attached: invite-email-variants-v3.html (3 variants), rsvp-segments.xlsx (segmentation by ARR & tech stack), tracking-links.txt (UTM + HubSpot links).

Key asks (short):
- Sergio / Jonas: take the top 30 named accounts in the "high-touch" tab and add a personalization note (1–2 lines) by EOD Friday. We will seed personal invites Monday 15th.
- Laura: confirm the reminder cadence in the console (automated send + 2 manual sales follow-ups). Can you add the 48hr + 2hr reminders and confirm timezone fallback rules?
- Mina: please confirm we have invite-only promo codes for partners and partners@cloudforum.org.

Email cadence (proposed):
1) Day 0: Official invite (variant A/B/C segmented) — marketing send
2) Day 3: Nudge with 1-sentence value prop + CTA — marketing
3) Day 5: Personalized sales outreach for named accounts — sales rep send
4) 48 hours before event: automated reminder + add calendar link — marketing
5) 2 hours before: final reminder (short) — marketing

Please reply inline with confirmations/edits.

Thanks — Marissa
—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
